scope: G7 paid-provider evidence gate and authorization blocker review

repair.change: No provider implementation change was made. The local paid-evidence gate is fail-closed and the remaining model snapshot, billing, authorization, and external verification requirements cannot be generated locally.

source_review: validate_paid_evidence() rejects missing or malformed model snapshot and billing files before provider construction.
Structurally valid temporary manifests remain PRESENT_UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL and do not assert formal paid-run permission.
The runner requires explicit --allow-paid and still requires snapshot/billing evidence before reading the key and constructing the provider.
unlock_conditions: Explicit user authorization for a paid pilot
Positive hard USD ceiling and frozen provider/model/run scope
Independently verifiable immutable model or gateway-weight evidence
Independent isolation review before any scientific acceptance

findings.evidence: The local gate and 29 protocol tests pass, but no authorized paid run, immutable model snapshot, independent billing evidence, or external review is present. A structurally valid local manifest remains PRESENT_UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL by design.
findings.remediation: Keep the paid gate closed. Obtain explicit authorization, a positive hard USD ceiling, independently verifiable model/billing evidence, and an independent isolation review before any real-provider pilot.
findings.blocker: Required authorization and external evidence are unavailable; no local-only test can establish them.

git.note: No paid provider call or external coordination was initiated.
